title: 第23章 天赋战技第24章 雷鸣兽的厉害
slug: 剑道狂神第4623章一枚令牌
lines: 对于凡思仁的话，唐天根本就没有多余的时间去考虑。
而此刻天雷蟒身形距离叶如雪有近了一些，巨大的尾巴呼啸卷起，一个翻转，狠狠的砸向叶如雪。
“叶姑娘小心！”
唐天大喝一声，身形如同炮弹一般，迅速的向天雷蟒掠去，要将他挡住。
实在是修为差距太大，厮杀太过艰难。
偏偏凡爷要求唐天必须将天雷蟒斩杀，对于他的话，自然选择听从。
“天外流星！”
目前已唐天的修为，仅仅勉强学会了这一招。
也正是这一招，如同流星划破长空，是的他的剑招速度奇快无比，整个人都因为剑招，速度变得更快。
长剑刺进了天雷蟒的体内，却因为坚固的蛇鳞，卡在体内，无法拔出。
唐天一跃而起，顺着天雷蟒巨大的身躯，不断的狂奔，来到了硕大的头顶上。
“去死！”
唐天手中光芒一闪，又是一柄长剑在手，狠狠的刺进了天雷蟒的另一只眼中。
“嗷吼！”
鲜血飞溅，更加激发了天雷蟒的凶性。
天雷蟒张开血盆大口，雷电闪烁，不断的凝聚，毁灭的气息越来越强。
叶如雪知道时间紧迫，急忙向着雷樱花冲去。
“冲着女人动手，算什么？有本事冲我来！”
唐天冷笑一声，手持长剑，向着天雷谷外，拼了命的跑去。
天雷蟒因为愤怒，早就失去了理智，尤其是现在双眼已经瞎了，只能靠着气息，追去。
至于雷樱花和天雷藤，已经管不了那么多了。
此时此刻，天雷蟒心中只有一个想法，就是不顾一切代价，先弄死唐天这货！
不弄死，不足以平蛇愤啊！
叶如雪看着唐天远去的身影，冰冷的眼眸，浮现起一抹担忧。
天雷蟒的实力，她都看在眼里，强大的肉身防御，除了实力强大以外，没有神兵利器，很难破开。
落星宗弟子的长剑，都只是一些普通的兵器，仅仅只是凡器而已。
在天圣大陆，兵器分为这些等级：凡器、灵器、神器。
每一个等级又分为四个品阶，下品、中品、上品、极品。
落星宗的外门弟子，别看在外面很风光，可随身携带的兵器，也仅仅凡器中品而已，连个上品都算不上。
西门莲身份高贵，兵器倒是凡器上品，却被唐天毁了。
叶如雪手中的长剑则是凡器极品，却没有办法借给唐天使用。
“我不会让你失望！”
现在没有了天雷蟒的干扰，叶如雪已经来到了雷樱花属下。
“小雷，自己吃吧，能吃多少吃多少，吃不完，我们带走。”
叶如雪轻轻说道，雷鸣兽点了点头，化作一道流光，便已经蹿到了雷樱花树上。
她并不知道，凡思仁对唐天的交代，只是以为，唐天在用生命引走了天雷蟒。
若是知道唐天并不只是要引走，而是要杀了天雷蟒，怕是要惊呆了。
叶如雪素手连动，迅速的采集天雷藤和雷樱花。
再说唐天，以最快的速度向着天雷谷外跑去，同时也在注意身后天雷蟒的动静。
时刻注意，若是天雷蟒没有跟出来的话，那叶如雪和雷鸣兽可就危险了。
好在没有失望，天雷蟒在后面紧追不舍。
血盆大口之中，雷电还在聚集成一个圆球，毁灭的气息愈发恐怖。
“我靠，这哪里是锻骨境高阶的妖兽？就是藏府境也没这么恐怖吧？”
content_en:
Tang Tian didn't have any extra time to think about Fan Siren's words.
At this moment, the Sky Thunder Python was a little closer to Ye Ruxue. Its huge tail roared and rolled up, flipped over, and hit Ye Ruxue hard.
"Miss Ye, be careful!"
Tang Tian shouted loudly, and like a cannonball, he quickly flew towards the Sky Thunder Python to block him.
The gap in cultivation is really too big, and the fight is too difficult.
However, Master Fan asked Tang Tian to kill the Thunder Python, so he naturally chose to obey his words.
"Meteor from the sky!"
At Tang Tian's current level of cultivation, he could barely learn this move.
It was this move that was like a meteor streaking across the sky. Yes, his sword move was extremely fast. His whole body became faster because of the sword move.
"Boom!"
The long sword pierced the body of the Sky Thunder Python, but because of the strong snake scales, it was stuck in the body and could not be pulled out.
Tang Tian jumped up and ran along the huge body of the Thunder Python until he reached the top of the huge head.
"Go to hell!"
Light flashed in Tang Tian's hand, and another long sword was in his hand, which pierced the other eye of the Thunder Python fiercely.
"Ouch!"
The splatter of blood further aroused the ferocity of the Thunder Python.
The thunder python opened its bloody mouth, thunder and lightning flashed, and they continued to condense, and the aura of destruction became stronger and stronger.
Ye Ruxue knew that time was running out and rushed towards Lei Yinghua.
"What does it mean to attack a woman? Come at me if you can!"
Tang Tian sneered, held a long sword, and ran towards the outside of Tianlei Valley with all his strength.
The Heavenly Thunder Python has long lost its mind because of its anger, especially now that its eyes are blind, so it can only rely on its breath to chase after him.
As for Thunder Sakura and Tian Lei Teng, they can no longer control that much.
At this moment, Tianlei Python has only one thought in his mind, which is to kill Tang Tian first at all costs!
If you don't kill him, it won't satisfy the snake's anger!
Ye Ruxue looked at Tang Tian's retreating figure, with a hint of worry in her cold eyes.
She has seen the strength of the Heavenly Thunder Python. In addition to its powerful physical defense, it is difficult to break through without magical weapons.
The long swords of the Fallen Star Sect disciples are just ordinary weapons, just mortal weapons.
In Tiansheng Continent, weapons are divided into these levels: mortal weapons, spiritual weapons, and divine weapons.
Each level is divided into four grades, low grade, medium grade, top grade, and top grade.
The outer disciples of Luo Xing Sect may look very good on the outside, but the weapons they carry with them are only middle-grade weapons, not even top-grade weapons.
Ximen Lian was of noble status, and her weapons were of the highest quality, but they were destroyed by Tang Tian.
The long sword in Ye Ruxue's hand was a top-quality weapon, but there was no way to lend it to Tang Tian for use.
"I won't let you down!"
Now that there is no interference from the Sky Thunder Python, Ye Ruxue has arrived under Thunder Yinghua.
"Xiao Lei, you can eat as much as you want. If you can't finish it, we will take it away."
Ye Ruxue said softly, and the thunder beast nodded, turned into a stream of light, and jumped to the thunder cherry tree.
She didn't know that Fan Siren's explanation to Tang Tian was that Tang Tian was using his life to lure away the Thunder Python.
If he knew that Tang Tian didn't just want to lure him away, but wanted to kill the Thunder Python, he would probably be shocked.
Ye Ruxue moved her hands together to quickly collect thunder vines and thunder cherry blossoms.
As for Tang Tian, ​​he ran towards the outside of Tianlei Valley as fast as he could, while also paying attention to the movements of the Heavenly Thunder Python behind him.
Always pay attention, if the Sky Thunder Python does not follow, then Ye Ruxue and the Thunder Beast will be in danger.
Fortunately, he was not disappointed, as the Thunder Python was chasing after him.
In the bloody mouth, thunder and lightning were still gathering into a ball, and the aura of destruction became more and more terrifying.
"Holy crap, how can this be a high-level monster in the Bone Forging Realm? Even the Zangfu Realm isn't that scary, right?"
